research.notes: Only the practice's own single-page website was used; no registry (CA SOS, SAM.gov) entry was checked, so legal name and registry IDs are null. The only email shown on the site is a named person's address, so it was omitted. Some third-party directories list a different Oakland address (230 Grand Ave), so the address may have changed over time. The website does not mention OUSD directly; identity rests on name, city, service type and the named clinician matching the agenda contract titles. The practice is a business with staff but is closely tied to one clinician; a reviewer may wish to confirm it is not a sole proprietor contracting in her own name.

profile.summary: Think Communication Therapy is a speech-language pathology practice in Oakland, California. It provides assessments, therapy and education for children with speech, language and hearing disorders, mainly ages 0-5 and school-age. It offers private therapy, early intervention services through the Regional Center of the East Bay, and consultation and screenings in preschool settings.

review.notes: The practice website matches the agenda name, the Oakland location, the speech-language service type and the named clinician Emily Vincent from the contract titles; the summary matches the site text and is neutral. The site does not state a legal structure, so orgType 'company' is unsupported and may be a sole proprietorship.
